entries.title: Fixed Cross Chord Bars and Hollow Pin String Zither
entries.description: One newly authored complete chord-bar zither-style static instrument exterior. One low clipped-shoulder hollow soundbox has a true round sound hole through the full upper skin and a finite closed bottom. Thirteen complete lengthwise strings run between two whole end banks and separately rooted anchor pins. A distinct transverse fixed chord-bar bank crosses over the strings: two complete side bearing rails support five whole crossbars with separated lower pad appearances and raised staggered buttons. This is not the old paired transverse courses crossing two central dulcimer bridges, nor a wheel-bowed pear instrument with a longitudinal keybox and side crank. The complete hollow-body, longitudinal string field and cross-string bar/control organization is new geometry, with no old visible meshes imported and no string-count variant claim. One whole model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Fixed simplified instrument appearance only: no calibrated chord mapping, working dampers or key travel, string tension, pitch, resonance, acoustic response, playability, cultural authenticity, manufacture or safety capability. No performer, pick, case, rigging, animation or interaction.
